definitions.explanation: The act of devoting all one's strength and effort to achieving something. A formal term often used in business and official contexts.

examples.japanese: ご{尽力|じんりょく}いただきありがとうございます。
{成功|せいこう}のために{尽力|じんりょく}する。
examples.english: To make every effort for success.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}{解決|かいけつ}に{尽力|じんりょく}してまいりますので、{今|いま}しばらくお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: We are working hard to resolve the issue, so please wait a little longer.

notes:
{尽力|じんりょく} is a formal term for making great effort or exerting oneself.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ご{尽力|じんりょく}いただき (for your efforts - honorific)
- {尽力|じんりょく}してまいります (I/we will do our best - humble)
- {尽力|じんりょく}を{惜|お}しまない (spare no effort)

USAGE NOTE: More formal than {頑張|がんば}る or {努力|どりょく}. Often used in business correspondence and formal speeches to acknowledge or promise dedicated effort.
